messages:
jordan: Heads-up: kicked off users.add_partial_index during the 03:30 maintenance window and we're seeing lock escalation on writes.

lee: noticed. Primary tx_wait spikes, some services hitting 503s from timeouts.

deploybot: alert: migration job users.add_partial_index (id=2026-05-10-users-idx) entered PAUSE state due to lock_wait > 75s for 3 checks. Canary routing switched to stable.

jordan: that PAUSE means we should evaluate rollback vs resume. Current release tag is v4.0.2-canary. Prod routing not yet fully flipped but we should be cautious.

nora: sanity check for rollback triggers? We set: sustained 5m p99 > 1s OR error_rate > 0.4% -> abort.

lee: p99 hit 1.2s for 6m and error_rate at 0.7% (deadlocks + unique_violation). Matches abort criteria.

jordan: ok, plan suggestion: abort migration job, pin deploy routing to v4.0.1, create a cleanup job to DROP INDEX IF EXISTS users_idx_partial_20260510, and update release-notes with incident.

deploybot: recommended command: deploybot stop-job --id=2026-05-10-users-idx --mode=graceful

lee: we should also snapshot the DB and collect querystats before stopping. Add that to the checklist.

jordan: agreed. I'll run snapshot and then stop.

product-bot: note: tagging incident severity S3 per playbook (partial outage on user reads).

jordan: snapshot created: s3://redwood-backups/snapshots/20260510-users-idx-3111112223.tar.gz

deploybot: executing stop. ETA 40s.

sre-bot: FYI replica lag at stop request = 34s, suppressing noisy alerts.

deploybot: job state: STOPPED (graceful). Partial index found: users_idx_partial_20260510.

lee: running cleanup plan now: 1) DROP INDEX CONCURRENTLY users_idx_partial_20260510 2) run ddl-validate --target=staging 3) schedule segmented backfill PR.

jordan: please coordinate the DROP CONCURRENTLY with traffic low window; prefer 04:30 UTC.

nora: adding to compliance: record abort reason and link to logs. Also add author of migration (jordan) and approver to the release ticket.

jordan: creating release-notes PR: https://git.internal/redwood/release-notes/pull/458 (WIP), will add incident blurb and rollback instructions.

lee: after cleanup and verification we'll plan a retry with chunked backfill and index build offloaded to read-replica to minimize lock pressure. Also consider KV prefix caching to reduce hot rows.

jordan: owners: jordan -> abort + notes, lee -> cleanup + retry plan, nora -> compliance snapshot, sre -> poststop monitoring.

deploybot: archived job logs: https://internal.logs/jobs/2026-05-10-users-idx (infra access).

lee: monitoring shows primary latency returning to baseline. I'll keep extra retention on querystats for 24h.

jordan: thanks team. We'll draft the postmortem and schedule a short huddle tomorrow.

nora: PR updated with compliance snapshot and log links. Closing thread for operational handoff. :white_check_mark:
